_comment: Every user-facing string in both clients, in one place — see tokens/build-strings.mjs for how this becomes android-app's res/values/strings.xml and web-app/strings.js. {name}-style placeholders are positional in the order they first appear in the English text; the Android generator turns them into %1$s/%2$s/... automatically, so don't reorder a placeholder within one language's text without checking the generator still lines them up the same way for every other language file added later. A key that only makes sense on one platform (e.g. common.back, web-only) still gets generated on both — the unused side is harmless. call.secondsSingular/secondsPlural is a plain two-way split (count==1 vs not), picked in code (HomeScreens.kt), not real CLDR plural-rule support — fine for English/German (both only ever need singular vs plural), but a future language with more plural categories (e.g. Slavic 1/2-4/5+ forms) would need this reworked, not just translated.

nameEntry.subtitle: Shown to other devices during pairing and in their contacts list.

kioskMode.title: Kiosk mode
kioskMode.subtitle: Bring Porchlight up automatically after (re)boot and when the screensaver ends

update.disabled: Update checking isn't set up for this build.

pairing.instructions1: Agree on a short phrase together — on a phone call, or however else you're in touch right now — then have both of you type the exact same phrase into your own device.
pairing.instructions2: Choose a phrase only the two of you would think of — avoid a common word, a name, or a short number.
pairing.instructions3: This only needs to be done once — once paired, you'll be able to call each other any time.
pairing.collisionMessage: More than one other device responded to that phrase at once. This may just be a coincidence (or someone else guessing the same words) — try again with a fresh phrase only the two of you would pick.
pairing.timeoutMessage: Nobody answered that phrase in time. Check that the other device is on this same screen and typed the exact same phrase, then try again.
pairing.confirmSubtitle: Both sides typed the same phrase.

outcome.neverConnectedMessage: The call with {name} never connected. Check that both devices have a working internet connection, then try again.
outcome.droppedMessage: The call with {name} disconnected unexpectedly — usually just a brief network issue.

notifications.callStatusChannelDesc: Shows when the camera and microphone are active during a call.
notifications.updateChannelDesc: A newer Porchlight build is ready to install.
